sections.title: About IWCMPQC 2027
paragraphs: The International Workshop and Conference on Mathematical Models for Post-Quantum Cryptography and its Applications (IWCMPQC 2027) brings together global cryptographers, mathematicians, cybersecurity engineers, and industrial leaders to explore how foundational mathematical frameworks—including Linear Algebra, Abstract Algebra, Fuzzy Logic, Functional Analysis, Probability Theory, and Numerical Methods—solve complex security challenges in the post-quantum era, emphasizing next-generation cryptographic primitives, cryptanalysis, and practical deployments across Industrial Control Systems (ICS/SCADA), IoT, Smart Grids, Cloud/Edge networks, and automated manufacturing.

sections.title: About the GRI
paragraphs: Founded in 1956 by Dr. G. Ramachandran and Dr. T. S. Soundaram Ramachandran based on Mahatma Gandhi's Nai Talim philosophy, The Gandhigram Rural Institute (GRI) pioneers rural higher education by organically integrating teaching, research, and extension. Conferred Deemed University status by UGC in 1976 and accredited with NAAC 'A' Grade, GRI is renowned for holistic, value-based education and scientific excellence.

sections.title: About CMMQC
paragraphs: The Centre for Mathematical Modelling and Quantum Computing (CMMQC) is a specialized research centre at The Gandhigram Rural Institute, functioning in association with the Department of Mathematics. CMMQC leads interdisciplinary research in mathematical modelling, quantum computing, quantum dynamics, post-quantum cryptography, and AI, driving global collaboration and advanced algorithmic developments for quantum technologies.

sections.title: About CUSAT
paragraphs: Constituted in 1971 by an Act of the Government of Kerala, Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) is a premier world-ranking university dedicated to advanced studies and cutting-edge research in applied sciences, engineering, and technology. CUSAT is consistently featured in the Times Higher Education World Rankings, QS World Rankings, and the NIRF rankings of India.

sections.title: About Department of Mathematics, CUSAT
paragraphs: Established in 1976 as a Centre of Excellence in mathematical sciences and applications, the Department of Mathematics at CUSAT conducts prestigious M.Sc. and Ph.D. programmes with scholars frequently admitted to IITs, IMSc, ISI, and TIFR. The department actively champions advanced research in pure and applied mathematics, fostering next-generation mathematical leadership.
